svg.title: BC / Forests, Lands and Natural Resource Operations / BCTS
svg.desc: Clean reconstruction using shared native primitives and explicit smooth geometry; no photograph contour tracing. Smooth shared geometry and authentic native charge primitives replace raster contours. Caption wording and arrangement follow this source; substitute outlined caption fonts and source fitting are approximate; clean source-authored tree/wildlife scenes are reused directly. The narrow raster export is fitted uniformly to the verified common native oval and BCTS lockup; its horizontal compression is not reproduced.
